amlsim_specific: Validation Y=0 has a 0.653988 zero atom; C1 has 0.418279 and C0 has 0.881612.
C1 positive Y=0 mass is concentrated below gap 1 (conditional KS 0.773860 at 0.9999998).
41.8279% of C1 Y=0 samples are at the lower support boundary.
common: C1 improves Y=1 gap KS, classwise coherence, and receiver TV but worsens Y=0 gap KS.
Positive-only Y=0 KS is worse for C1 than C0.
Train-to-validation shift is materially smaller than C1 Y=0 generation error.
Frozen evaluator-bin mapping masks part of the continuous discrepancy and is not the cause.
sparkov_specific: No zero atom exists; C1 Y=0 failure is entirely positive-gap distribution mismatch.
The Y=0 KS supremum is at validation gap 81,520, with C1 cumulative mass lower by 0.0695224.
5.49979% of C1 Y=0 samples are at the encoded upper support boundary and 10.8788% fall in the last evaluator bin.

final_decision.rationale: It is the only listed conclusion supported in both datasets. A zero-inflated hurdle is AMLSim-specific, while shift and bin mapping are refuted as primary causes.

evaluator_bin_mapping_primary.evidence: Mapping C1 continuous gaps to frozen bins reduces, rather than creates, Y=0 KS by 0.0212473/0.0180851.

positive_gap_conditional_calibration_pro.evidence: C1 positive-only Y=0 KS exceeds C0 on both datasets; AMLSim concentrates positive mass below 1 while Sparkov overweights the upper tail/support boundary.

train_validation_shift_primary.evidence: Y=0 train-validation KS is 0.0276605/0.0127674 versus C1 error 0.235709/0.0695224 for AMLSim/Sparkov.

zero_inflated_hurdle_gap_head_needed.evidence: AMLSim Y=0 zero-atom mismatch equals the raw KS supremum, but Sparkov has no zero atom and still fails Y=0.

method.c0_gap_representation: gap_tau[C0.dt_bin], identical to the frozen C1 parent-gate surrogate
